_comment: Georgia 2026-2027 QAP, Georgia Department of Community Affairs. Page numbers are PDF page indices, matching the printed page numbers. Scoring Criteria pp.79-115; the p.80 applicability matrix is drawn with graphic checkmarks invisible to the text layer and was read from a rendered image. FOUR UNIVERSES: New Affordability and Preservation, each at 9% and 4%/Bonds. Coded as a shared core plus add-on tracks. Default track = the nine criteria scored in both 9% competitions (III-IX, all universes; XXII-XXIII, 9% only): 6 + 5 + 10 + 5 + 15 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 2.5 = 50.5. new_affordability adds X-XXI: 20 + 6 + 3 + 13 (one of XIII-XVI) + 5 (Phased 4 or Previous 5) + 1 + 1 + 2 = 51, for 101.5. preservation adds XXIV: 6 + 6 + 4 (Age or Restrictions) + 20 (site criteria, capped) + 3 + 3 (USDA) = 42, for 92.5. The 4% universes are not separate tracks. 4% New Affordability omits XV, XX, XXI, XXII and XXIII and caps its site criteria at 33 (p.81). 4% Preservation omits XXII and XXIII and adds two USDA Portfolio criteria (track four_pct_usda_portfolio). NO TOTAL IS STATED; 'Maximum points vary by Application type' (p.112). The loader matched every hand-summed track. Contradictions recorded: Community Designations A (13 in its headings, ten in its text); DCA Community Initiatives B (2.5 points, 'this point').

track_totals.note: Shared 9% core, 50.5. Seven of the nine criteria also score 4% applications. No total stated.
Add-on for New Affordability: 51, for a 9% New Affordability maximum of 101.5. Computed, not stated.
Add-on for Preservation: 42, for a 9% Preservation maximum of 92.5. 'Maximum points vary by Application type.' The USDA criteria apply only to USDA properties.
Two USDA criteria for 4% Credits/Bonds Portfolio applications only, 16 points.
